tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search file contents with ripgrep and return matching lines grouped by file.

pattern.description: ripgrep regular expression (Rust syntax: no lookaround or backreferences). Use literal when the text contains regex characters.

path.description: File or directory to search, relative to cwd or absolute. Defaults to the workspace root. Explicit paths are searched even when ignored or hidden.

include.description: Only search files matching this glob, for example "*.ts" or "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}".

literal.description: Treat the pattern as exact text instead of a regular expression.

context.description: Lines of context to show before and after each match.
